suites.name: Frontend API Contracts & Demo Data Integrity

tests.name: should generate exactly 96 15-minute readings for 24 hours
should generate 20-step multi-horizon forecast data with monotonic 95% >= 80% intervals
should simulate What-If postprandial trajectories with peak, nadir, and TIR
should preserve static profile 9-channel schema
should enforce clinical research disclaimer string
should sanitize forecast payload against circular React SyntheticEvent objects
should format patient update PUT request with Bearer token and 9 canonical fields
should compute distinct Historical In-Range and 5-Hour Projected In-Range without 94.2% fallback
should map 5 hourly milestone steps in chronological order matching point_forecast_mg_dl
should derive origin glucose and peak projection strictly without synthetic fallbacks
should enforce origin precedence: API origin takes precedence over history, history used only if API is null
should handle non-hourly peak index (+75m) and format timing accurately without confusing hourly milestones
should sanitize non-finite numbers and reject inverted uncertainty intervals
should preserve base forecast mean trajectory under filter toggle operations and What-If scenarios
should gracefully handle empty history with valid current_state by prepending NOW anchor
Case 1: Normal forecast with complete response evaluates all 20 steps and intervals
Case 2: Missing optional risk-assessment fields derives peak from trajectory and maintains nominal state
Case 3: Telemetry pending with historical readings anchors origin to latest CGM and displays unavailable for forecast
Case 4: Empty history and no valid origin renders null origin without synthetic numbers
Case 5: Short forecast array (5 steps) populates valid milestones and marks remaining steps as unavailable
Case 6: Missing uncertainty intervals flags unavailable and renders mean line cleanly
Case 7: Forecast with peak at non-hourly index (+30m) formats peak accurately without altering hourly rows
Case 8: What-If scenario present and absent toggles overlay cleanly without mutating base forecast
Case 9: API error or unavailable backend results in null forecast with graceful awaiting status
